title: DSPy Program Execution
summary: This module orchestrates how DSPy programs run, encompassing advanced prediction strategies, agentic control flow, real-time output streaming, external tool integration, and robust prediction aggregation.

nodes.label: Advanced Prediction Strategies
nodes.title: DSPy Prediction Strategies
nodes.description: Implements sophisticated prediction techniques like ReAct, Program-of-Thought, and BestOfN to enhance the quality and robustness of DSPy program outputs.

nodes.label: Agentic Control Flow
nodes.title: Program Control Flow (Avatar)
nodes.description: Manages iterative, agentic execution loops, allowing programs to dynamically decide actions, execute tools, and adapt their strategy until a task is complete.

nodes.label: Output Streaming
nodes.title: DSPy Streaming Capabilities
nodes.description: Enables real-time, incremental output generation from DSPy programs, providing immediate feedback and supporting integration with streaming APIs.

nodes.label: Tool Execution & Sandboxing
nodes.title: Tool Execution Primitives
nodes.description: Provides core mechanisms for executing external tools, managing sandboxed environments, and handling data serialization for interactive REPL contexts within DSPy programs.

nodes.label: Prediction Aggregation
nodes.title: Prediction Aggregation Utilities
nodes.description: Offers utilities for combining multiple predictions, typically using majority voting, to produce a single, robust output from a set of generated completions.

groups.label: Core Execution Flow
groups.title: Core Execution Flow
groups.description: The central components that define how DSPy programs execute, make predictions, and manage their overall flow.

groups.label: Auxiliary Execution Features
groups.title: Auxiliary Execution Features
groups.description: Supporting functionalities that enhance program execution, including real-time output, external tool integration, and result consolidation.
